title: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
description: An Act to provide for more effective protection of the rights of women guaranteed under the Constitution who are victims of violence of any kind occurring within the family.

title: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012
description: An Act to protect children from offences of sexual assault, sexual harassment and pornography.

title: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007
description: An Act to provide for more effective provisions for the maintenance and welfare of parents and senior citizens guaranteed and recognised under the Constitution.

title: Information Technology Act, 2000
description: An Act to provide legal recognition for transactions carried out by means of electronic data interchange and other means of electronic communication.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
description: An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers and for the said purpose, to establish authorities for timely and effective administration.
